candidate_windows.window_text:
For the teacher model, we train the HRKD-teacher for three epochs with a learning rate of 5e-5. For

the student model, we train it for ten epochs with a learning rate of 1e-3 and 5e-4 on MNLI and Amazon Reviews, respectively. $\gamma$ is set to 1, and $t$ is 1. For few-shot learning, the learning rate for the student model is 5e-5, while other hyper-parameters are kept the same. The few-shot training data is selected from the front of our original training set with different sample ratios, while the dev and test data are the same as our original dev and test sets without sampling to make a fair comparison. In all the experiments, the sequence length is set to 128, and the batch size is 32. The hyper-parameters are tuned on the development set, and the results are averaged over five runs. Our experiments are conducted on 4 GeForce RTX 3090 GPUs.
